conventions.time: UTC in 2024; TAI-UTC=37 s; TT=TAI+32.184 s; TDB from each engine; no event-time conversion claim
conventions.eop: Reuse Mission 34 frozen daily IERS rows, linear DUT1 and polar motion; no downloads
conventions.site: WGS84 geodetic latitude, east-positive longitude, ellipsoidal elevation in metres
conventions.reference_targets: DE421 system barycentres 1,2,4,5,6,7,8; Mercury/Venus centre segments coincide and Mars segment is zero in this kernel. No resolved planetary disk-centre qualification for giant planets.
conventions.angles: Apparent topocentric directions; RA/Dec on non-precessed ICRS-aligned axes (not true equator/equinox of date); reference includes light-time, aberration and gravitational deflection
conventions.distance: Observer-to-retarded-target astrometric distance; apparent transformation preserves norm to floating precision
conventions.horizontal: Unrefracted altitude; azimuth north=0 east=90; no horizon dip, limb, atmosphere or terrain
conventions.production: Astropy builtin ERFA PLAN94 approximate planets, EPV00 Earth, existing Moon model; not switched to a JPL kernel

rationale.direction: Fixed planner-scale acceptance goals informed by ERFA PLAN94's historical heliocentric errors and geocentric amplification. These goals are not converted confidence bounds or global maxima. Mercury/Venus 30 arcsec; Mars 90; Jupiter 120; Saturn/Uranus 180; Neptune 60. Any failure remains reported, not fitted away.
rationale.distance: Fixed conservative regression budgets covering radial plus transverse heliocentric approximation contributions projected onto observer range. ERFA's tabulated R error alone is not a topocentric range bound. No physical covariance or statistical coverage is asserted.
rationale.separations: Triangle-inequality budgets: planetary direction goal plus existing Mission 34 Sun 5 arcsec / Moon 60 arcsec allowance.
rationale.azimuth: 12 exceeds sec(85 degrees); full horizontal direction remains checked at zenith where azimuth is excluded.
rationale.solar: Within 3 degrees of Sun, angular comparisons are retained as diagnostics but excluded from qualification because deflection/occultation conventions are not matched. Range and output contracts remain gated.
rationale.classifications: Within direction tolerance of altitude 0/20 degrees, classification is boundary_indeterminate; reference labels outside guards must agree. Cardinal directions similarly guard 22.5+45k boundaries. Contracts using actual returned angles are always checked.
